description: Every Cloudflare API permission the yaran control-plane Worker needs, and why. The one home: token-template.ts builds the account-owned token template URL from it, the setup wizard's capability probe walks it, and a test checks the deploy README link against it. IDs marked source=datamine are unverified until gate G9 resolves them through GET /accounts/{id}/tokens/permission_groups; G9's evidence replaces them and drops the marker.

permissions.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Edit
permissions.purpose: Create, configure, rotate and delete one tunnel per paired machine, and read each tunnel's status.

permissions.name: Access: Apps and Policies Edit
permissions.purpose: Create the control-plane Access application and one per machine, and keep the reusable yaran users policy in step with your pairing policy.

permissions.name: Access: Organizations, Identity Providers, and Groups Edit
permissions.purpose: Read your Zero Trust team domain, add a One-time PIN, GitHub or Google sign-in, list Access groups for the pairing policy, and sign a user out everywhere.

permissions.name: Workers Scripts Edit
permissions.purpose: Attach the control plane's custom domain, turn the workers.dev address off once setup closes, and confirm this Worker's script name.

permissions.name: DNS Edit
permissions.purpose: Create one proxied CNAME per paired machine in the zone you choose. Limit it to that zone in the token form.

permissions.name: Zone Read
permissions.purpose: List your zones so you can pick one, and resolve its zone id. Limit it to that zone in the token form.

excluded.name: Access: Service Tokens
excluded.reason: Machines sign their calls with Ed25519 keys (D6), so no service token is ever created.

excluded.name: D1 and Workers Builds
excluded.reason: The Deploy to Cloudflare button uses its own credentials for those.

excluded.name: Account API Tokens
excluded.reason: The Worker must never be able to mint tokens.

excluded.name: Account Settings Read
excluded.reason: Added only if gate G9 shows GET /accounts needs it for account-owned tokens.
